title: CallDetailResponse
description:
Full call detail — the canonical response for GET /calls/{call_id}.

This is the single source of truth for the call detail shape. The OpenAPI
spec is generated from this model. The SDK TypeScript types are generated
from the spec. The developer-console consumes SDK types directly.

timebase.description: Canonical timebase shared by waveform, overlays, seek state, zoom, and scroll transforms.

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Canonical actor/system lane model. Every segment lane_id resolves against this collection.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable canonical lane id used by timeline visualizations. Segments attach via TimelineSegment.lane_id; consumers should not re-infer lanes from CSS or pixel positions.

track.title: Track
track.description: High-level actor-semantic track for styling and grouping.

order.title: Order
order.description: Stable vertical order within the timeline lane model.

actor.description: Actor represented by this lane when applicable.

track.title: Track
track.description: Actor-semantic display track for the segment. Inferred for legacy producers.

lane_id.title: Lane Id
lane_id.description: Canonical lane id. Must match PlaybackTimeline.lanes[].id after platform normalization.

order.title: Order
order.description: Canonical event order after platform time/lane normalization.

actor.description: Actor responsible for the segment. Inferred for legacy producers.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Zero point used for segment start/end offsets.

start.title: Start
start.description: Visible/canonical timeline range start in seconds.

end.title: End
end.description: Visible/canonical timeline range end in seconds.
